summary: XJO closed +0.01% at 8,731.9 — a flat headline masking negative breadth (90 adv/103 dec) as banks and healthcare offset a five-month-low tech rout (XIJ -1.60%). Financials led (XFJ +0.63%) on CBA/ANZ bringing forward RBA hike calls to 29 Sept (~90%, 4.60%). PPT -15.1% (EQT takeover rejected) and TLX -11.7% (ITM deal) were the large-cap casualties; RMS +6.15% on FY27 guidance. Materials fell as rare earths and gold gave back gains.
